correctness.rationale: The exact Ehrhart formula gives the sectional genus and Hurwitz degree for every n. The local rank-one 2-by-(n-2) Segre cone has length n-2 under a generic section. Its m branches have a trace evaluation determinant of valuation m-1, proved nonzero by Cauchy rational interpolation, hence each vertex correction is 2(m-1). All other orbits are smooth, so subtraction gives the stated bidegree. Computational checks confirm small n; they are not used as infinite proof.
